author: Times News
description:
"Netanyahu is trying to navigate a very fine line between consolidating his domestic support before the most consequential election in his political life on one hand, and trying to keep Donald Trump in his corner on the other."

If Netanyahu accepts Donald Trump’s 15-point peace plan, his coalition will collapse, ending his political career and exposing him to ongoing corruption trials, says Aaron David Miller, former US peace negotiator.

Aaron David Miller and Anshel Pfeffer were speaking to Carole Walker (in for Ayesha Hazarika) on Times Radio Drive. Listen live every Saturday and Sunday from 4–7pm.

description:
"It's very hard to overstate the importance of what is happening today. This is on the level of El Chapo being brought to New York to face charges."
